notes.title: Termination Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is NINEVR.

We are pleased to announce that the Eggfight, which was scheduled to close as January 5, 2020, has ended early November 6, 2019 

Thank you for using Eggfight, and we’ll be back with better content.

Thank you.

notes.title: EggFight Termination Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is NINEVR. 
Beginning March 21, 2019, EggFight serviced by STEAM, will close its services as January 5, 2020. 
Thank you for using Eggfight, and we’ll be back with better content.
 Thank you.
